entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The Good King, High King of the Realm on Eldraine, husband of Linden and father of Erec, Hazel, Rowan and Will; killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Linden Kenrith
entities.description: Queen of Eldraine, Algenus's wife and a canny fighter who broke the witch's spell with a kiss.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane ruled by the High King of the Realm.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Son of Algenus's with the witch, raised by Linden; one of the twins.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Twin son of Algenus, raised by Linden.

entities.name: Questing Beast
entities.description: Gave Linden and Kenrith blessed swords imbued with the power to bestow life.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Anarchist planeswalker who abducted Kenrith and turned him into a stag, and mortally wounded him while masquerading as Queen Ayara.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: Hunt during which Kenrith was mortally wounded by Oko.

entities.name: Restoration of the High King
entities.description: Linden's use of her sword's remaining life to return Kenrith to the living.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: Castle where Kenrith and Linden died defending against the invaders.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Kenrith was killed.

events.summary: Kenrith and Linden are chosen to quest for the high rulership and receive blessed swords from the Questing Beast.
events.quote: The Questing Beast had given both Linden and him blessed swords

events.summary: A witch enthralls Kenrith and kills the twins; Linden's kiss breaks the spell and she restores the twins with her sword.
events.quote: A kiss from Linden broke the spell on Kenrith

events.summary: Kenrith completes the High Quest and is proclaimed High King.
events.quote: Kenrith completed the High Quest and he was proclaimed the High King of the realm

events.summary: Oko abducts Kenrith and turns him into a stag.
events.quote: Kenrith was abducted by the anarchist Planeswalker Oko and turned into a magnificent stag

events.summary: Oko mortally wounds Kenrith during the Wild Hunt; Linden restores him with her sword.
events.quote: Linden used it for the Restoration of the High King

events.summary: Kenrith and Linden are killed defending Castle Ardenvale from the Phyrexians; his armies follow him as Spirits.
events.quote: were killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale

relations.quote: He was the husband of Queen Linden Kenrith
the father of Erec , Hazel , Rowan and Will Kenrith
